intended_object: The open cover of the glued scheme ⋃ U_i by the canonical open immersions ι_i : U_i → glued that come from the gluing data. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The cover is indexed by D.J. Its components are the schemes D.U i and its maps are the canonical maps D.ι i into the glued scheme. Each ι_i is an open immersion (an instance), and the ι_i are jointly surjective (`D.ι_jointly_surjective`), and these are the two conditions for being an open cover. This matches the standard fact that a scheme built by gluing is covered by the images of the pieces U_i. The definition is stated for arbitrary scheme gluing data, which is its natural generality. Mathlib has no separate declaration of the same object.
